{{Quote|Repeat: the bridge is under attack. They're using vertigon gas, and I think they're shooting the crewers&mdash;|Commander Gilad Pellaeon|<ref name="Choices" />}}
'''Vertigon gas''' was a [[Color/Legends|white]], [[Death/Legends|nonfatal]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] whose effects included loss of balance and slurred speech.<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> during his sabotage of the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']],<ref name="Choices" /> [[Storm-hair]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref> [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] used vertigon gas to incapacitate the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] crew. The [[Warship/Legends|warship's]] [[third bridge officer]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], donned a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] before Esva's gas could incapacitate him. The commander then reported that the warlord was using vertigon gas to the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} emergency channel. Shortly after, Pellaeon spoke with the Star Destroyer's [[Sensor officer/Legends|sensor officer]], hearing the [[Officer/Legends|officer's]] voice slurring with the aftereffects of Esva's gas.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vertigon gas appeared in the [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]'', which was written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Choices" />
